tokens.name: l-rail
tokens.usage: Layer 1, the slim icon rail at the far left (Trim). One step further from the page than the list. Text on it: l-text, l-muted, l-faint.

tokens.name: l-list
tokens.usage: Layer 2, the sidebar list and side panes (Now, Pinned, lanes, the thread panel). Replaces l-panel as the sidebar color.

tokens.name: l-bg
tokens.usage: Layer 3, the canvas: the page, the chat, inputs. The background seed. Every text token is checked on it.

tokens.name: l-raised
tokens.usage: Layer 4, what floats over the canvas: the composer, the approval dock, menus, popovers, the Quick ask panel, toasts. Pair with an l-shadow-* token.

tokens.name: l-panel
tokens.usage: A soft fill on the canvas: tiles, answer boxes, code blocks, the queued-message strip, branch cards. Not for the sidebar (that is l-list).

tokens.name: l-card
tokens.usage: Kept for today's code: the composer and floating cards. An alias of l-raised.

tokens.name: l-text
tokens.usage: Body text and names, on l-rail, l-list, l-bg, l-raised and l-panel. At least 12:1 everywhere (15:1 in High contrast).

tokens.name: l-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, hints, times, counts, process lines ("Worked for 42s"), row second lines. At least 4.5:1 on l-rail, l-list, l-bg, l-raised and l-panel in every theme (7:1 in High contrast).

tokens.name: l-faint
tokens.usage: Shortcut chips, disabled labels, crumb separators, the faded last row. At least 3:1 on l-rail, l-list, l-bg, l-raised and l-panel. Never for primary readable text.

tokens.name: l-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an l-accent fill (the primary button). Computed per theme: the page or the text color, whichever passes; never literal white.

tokens.name: l-on-bad
tokens.usage: Text on an l-bad fill (the unread count badge). Computed per theme.

tokens.name: l-line
tokens.usage: Dividers, card and row borders, header bottoms. The text color at 13 to 15% alpha so it sits right on every layer. Decorative: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: l-line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control: inputs, checkboxes, switch tracks, the secondary button in High contrast. At least 3:1 on l-rail, l-list, l-bg, l-raised and l-panel.

tokens.name: l-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on rows, quiet buttons and menu items. The text color at 5 to 7% alpha.

tokens.name: l-selected
tokens.usage: The open row in the sidebar, the pressed segment of a switch, the open pane tab. The text color at 9 to 12% alpha.

tokens.name: l-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. An alias of l-accent, which passes 3:1 on every layer.

tokens.name: l-accent
tokens.usage: The one action color: primary buttons, links, focus, "working", the open tab, a chosen chip's border. As text, at least 4.5:1 on l-rail, l-list, l-bg, l-raised and l-panel.

tokens.name: l-accent-soft
tokens.usage: A tint of the accent: the drop target while dragging, search match highlight, the selected row in the Cmd+K list. Never behind body text that needs l-accent.

tokens.name: l-glow
tokens.usage: Background mood "glow" only: the color of a radial glow behind empty screens and Home, on the canvas layer. Alpha is 0 unless the theme turns glow on, capped at 0.18. Never behind text in a card or inside a button.

tokens.name: l-ok
tokens.usage: Done, merged, checks passed, the +adds count, a live service dot. As text, at least 4.5:1 on l-rail, l-list, l-bg, l-raised and l-panel. Same hue in every theme.

tokens.name: l-ok-soft
tokens.usage: Behind added lines in a diff, behind a "Merged" toast. Under l-text, never under l-ok text in small sizes.

tokens.name: l-needs
tokens.usage: Needs you: the waiting mark, the ask under a row title, the approval count, the context gauge from 75%. As text, at least 4.5:1 on l-rail, l-list, l-bg, l-raised and l-panel. A deep amber in light mode, a bright amber in dark. Same hue in every theme; no lane uses it.

tokens.name: l-needs-soft
tokens.usage: Behind a needs-you card on the Needs-you page and the Priority section header. Under l-text.

tokens.name: l-bad
tokens.usage: Failed, errors, removed lines count, a down service, the context gauge from 90%, a safety-floor approval's bottom line. As text, at least 4.5:1 on l-rail, l-list, l-bg, l-raised and l-panel.

tokens.name: l-bad-soft
tokens.usage: Behind removed lines in a diff, behind a failed toast. Under l-text.

tokens.name: l-news
tokens.usage: Unread news: the 7px dot on a row with an unseen result. A mark, at least 3:1 on l-rail, l-list, l-bg, l-raised and l-panel. Not a text color.

tokens.name: l-type-1
tokens.usage: Lane color 1, blue. The lane's glyph tile border and Brain graph "concept" nodes. A mark (3:1), not a text color.

tokens.name: l-type-1-soft
tokens.usage: Lane color 1 tile fill, under the lane glyph in l-text.

tokens.name: l-type-2
tokens.usage: Lane color 2, orange. Lane tiles and Brain "source" nodes.

tokens.name: l-type-2-soft
tokens.usage: Lane color 2 tile fill, under l-text.

tokens.name: l-type-3
tokens.usage: Lane color 3, green. Lane tiles and Brain "project" nodes.

tokens.name: l-type-3-soft
tokens.usage: Lane color 3 tile fill, under l-text.

tokens.name: l-type-4
tokens.usage: Lane color 4, violet. Was amber: amber now means only "needs you" (l-needs). Lane tiles and Brain "person" nodes.

tokens.name: l-type-4-soft
tokens.usage: Lane color 4 tile fill, under l-text.

tokens.name: l-type-5
tokens.usage: Lane color 5, pink. Lane tiles and Brain "answer" nodes.

tokens.name: l-type-5-soft
tokens.usage: Lane color 5 tile fill, under l-text.

tokens.name: l-agent-claude
tokens.usage: Claude's color: its glyph (lucide feather) in a circle, everywhere Claude appears: sidebar, step rows, helper list, model chip. A mark (3:1), not a text color.

tokens.name: l-agent-claude-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of Claude's glyph circle.

tokens.name: l-agent-codex
tokens.usage: Codex's color: its glyph (lucide square-terminal) in a circle.

tokens.name: l-agent-codex-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of Codex's glyph circle.

tokens.name: l-agent-antigravity
tokens.usage: Antigravity (Gemini)'s color: its glyph (lucide orbit) in a circle.

tokens.name: l-agent-antigravity-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of Antigravity's glyph circle.

tokens.name: l-agent-qwen
tokens.usage: Qwen (local)'s color: its glyph (lucide cpu) in a circle.

tokens.name: l-agent-qwen-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of Qwen's glyph circle.

tokens.name: l-terminal
tokens.usage: The terminal pane: always dark, the theme's dark canvas in both modes, so ANSI colors read.

tokens.name: l-terminal-text
tokens.usage: Text in the terminal pane, on l-terminal.

tokens.name: l-paper
tokens.usage: White page under PDF previews and panel iframes, whose content assumes white. Always framed by a 1px l-line border and l-radius-md corners.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn's foreground, mapped to l-text.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn's card-foreground, mapped to l-text.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: shadcn popover, dropdown and dialog surfaces: raised, with a shadow.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn's popover-foreground, mapped to l-text.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: shadcn primary: the Lanes accent.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn's primary-foreground, mapped to l-on-accent.

tokens.name: secondary

tokens.name: secondary-foreground

tokens.name: muted

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn's muted-foreground, mapped to l-muted.

tokens.name: accent

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn's accent-foreground, mapped to l-text.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: shadcn's destructive, mapped to l-bad.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn's destructive-foreground, mapped to l-on-bad.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: shadcn's border, mapped to l-line.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: shadcn input borders: l-line-strong, so a field's edge passes 3:1. Changed from l-line.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: shadcn's ring, mapped to l-focus.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: shadcn sidebar: the list layer. Changed from l-panel.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn's sidebar-foreground, mapped to l-text.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: shadcn's sidebar-primary, mapped to l-accent.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn's sidebar-primary-foreground, mapped to l-on-accent.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: The open or hovered sidebar item: l-selected.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn's sidebar-accent-foreground, mapped to l-text.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: shadcn's sidebar-border, mapped to l-line.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: shadcn's sidebar-ring, mapped to l-focus.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Charts in widget cards: lane color 1.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Charts in widget cards: lane color 2.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Charts in widget cards: lane color 3.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Charts in widget cards: lane color 4.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Charts in widget cards: lane color 5.

styles.name: t-page-title
styles.usage: One per page, in the page header beside its icon. Lane names at the top of a lane.

styles.name: t-tile-value
styles.usage: Big numbers in stat tiles. Always tabular figures.

styles.name: t-brand
styles.usage: The app name at the top of the sidebar.

styles.name: t-panel-title
styles.usage: Side panel, sheet and dialog titles.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Pull the three newest PROMIS papers and summarize the methods.
styles.usage: Chat messages, answers, page copy. The default.

styles.name: t-body-strong
styles.usage: Section headings (h3), names in cards, the branch card title. Never a whole paragraph.

styles.name: t-row
styles.usage: Sidebar rows, list rows, settings row titles, secondary rows.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Labels, notes, meta, errors, process lines, tabs, chips in the composer.

styles.name: t-label-strong
styles.usage: A label that leads its line: the work summary, a dock title, a tool name.

styles.name: t-small
styles.sample: Needs you: approve push to main
styles.usage: Pills, counts, row second lines, row times, group headers, service dots.

styles.name: t-prose-h1
styles.usage: First heading in a Space page or a long Markdown answer.

styles.name: t-code
styles.usage: Code blocks, diffs, tool hints, the terminal.

styles.name: t-code-meta
styles.usage: Commit hashes and ids in meta lines.

tokens.name: l-space-2
tokens.usage: Between composer chips and inside a segmented switch.

tokens.name: l-space-4
tokens.usage: Icon to text in a tight pill; between tabs.

tokens.name: l-space-6
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons and work lines; between filter chips.

tokens.name: l-space-8
tokens.usage: The default gap: between buttons, row parts, stacked cards.

tokens.name: l-space-10
tokens.usage: Sidebar row padding; between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: l-space-12
tokens.usage: Composer padding; card padding top and bottom; between row icon and title in lists.

tokens.name: l-space-14
tokens.usage: Card padding left and right; the approval dock padding.

tokens.name: l-space-16
tokens.usage: Header side padding; phone page padding; between sections in a pane.

tokens.name: l-space-20
tokens.usage: Above a section heading in settings.

tokens.name: l-space-24
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: l-space-32
tokens.usage: Page padding on the Mac and MacBook.

tokens.name: l-space-48
tokens.usage: Inside an empty state box, top and bottom.

tokens.name: l-radius-xs
tokens.usage: Progress and bar ends, favicons (3px is fine), the prompt block.

tokens.name: l-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tabs, pane switches, segment buttons, lane tiles at 22px, shortcut chips.

tokens.name: l-radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, code blocks, the PDF and iframe frame. shadcn --radius.

tokens.name: l-radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards in lists, queued messages, error notes, the diff file frame.

tokens.name: l-radius-xl
tokens.usage: Tiles, status cards, empty states, the approval card in a branch card.

tokens.name: l-radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The composer, the approval dock, floating panels (Quick ask), dialogs.

tokens.name: l-radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, count badges, the "New messages" button.

shadow.note: Lines, not shadows. Only things that float get one.

tokens.name: l-shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The composer and the approval dock. Very soft.

tokens.name: l-shadow-menu

tokens.name: l-shadow-float
